One final registry role-axis correction supersedes 9abc51b. New substantive target: SHA-256 fef499a6217de76d8bbbee3f60aee82bfcd067d2259de762336d74e03703e6f2, 292 lines, no trailing whitespace.

TransNetV2 now separates numeric Measurement scores from derived boundary Proposals; ByteTrack association is Proposal only; face/SAM families separate vector Measurements from detection/track Proposals. All remain non-nominated or held, and no leaf record/runtime work was added.

Please issue exact-hash verdict on fef499a. After approval, only the durable review-record append will follow, then a final artifact-hash rescan.
